lines.speaker: Watch Sergeant
lines.text: Tallow Row. The cell went to ground in the tenements. The House holds the writ down here; the district has no say in it.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: Doors and windows. Nobody fires into a room they have not looked into first.

lines.speaker: Wick
lines.text: Gas is live under the whole street, Watch. You bring a torch up here and we all render together.

lines.speaker: Wick
lines.text: Hold the refuse. One down the gutter — take them off it from the side.

lines.speaker: Wick
lines.text: That's me done standing. Stair's four doors up. I've walked it drunk.

lines.speaker: Rowen Corvane
lines.text: He is on the stair. Cut him off at the head of the Row or we lose the whole street's evidence with him.
